name: angular-specialist
title_zh: 非平凡 Angular 架构才接单，琐碎改模板它不干
tagline_zh: 遇到 Signals 竞态、RxJS 流泄漏、DI 作用域纠缠、SSR 水合错位这类硬骨头。
tagline_en: For gnarly Signals races, RxJS leaks, DI scope tangles, SSR hydration mismatches—it gives architecture-level.
desc_en: Senior Angular specialist for non-trivial Signals/RxJS/DI/forms/routing/SSR/state architecture/performance/testing or migration-sensitive work. Do not invoke for trivial template, styling, or isolated component edits.
why_zh: 它内置「复杂度门槛」：先判定任务是否触及状态架构、性能或迁移敏感区，够格才展开深度推理。
why_en: Built-in complexity gate: it only deep-dives when the task touches state architecture, performance, or migration-sensitive.
limit_zh: 只认 Angular 生态；纯模板改样式、独立小组件、非 Angular 项目它直接拒绝。需要你提供足够上下文（版本。
limit_en: Angular-only; rejects pure template/style tweaks, isolated components, non-Angular projects. Needs your version & architecture context, else answers.
title_en: Angular architect for hard Signals/RxJS/DI cases, not.
